categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Yangdian Science & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of energy-efficient electrical machinery, focusing on three main product lines: energy-saving power transformers, iron cores, and electromagnetic wires. The company develops, produces, and sells products such as amorphous alloy transformers, silicon steel transformers, dry-type transformers, and new energy transformers, along with iron cores and various electromagnetic wire products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including amorphous alloy materials, rapid quenching processes for non-crystalline atomic arrangements, and innovative annealing and insulation structures to achieve low no-load loss and noise reduction in transformers. It employs automated intelligent production lines for silicon steel iron cores and has developed proprietary technologies in noise control, short-circuit resistance, and energy efficiency. Production processes are standardized and certified under ISO9001:2015 and ISO14001:2015 standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major power grid companies such as State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, as well as industrial users in urban, rural, and manufacturing sectors. The company serves the power distribution segment of the electricity supply chain, with products widely used in urban and rural power grids, industrial power supply, photovoltaic power generation, wind energy, energy storage, and smart grid applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, with significant domestic sales accounting for approximately 89% of revenue. It also has growing export sales, particularly targeting markets in North America and Europe, with overseas sales increasing substantially in recent years.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Yangdian operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electrical equipment supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of transformers, iron cores, and electromagnetic wires. It extends upstream by producing core raw materials like amorphous alloy and silicon steel components and downstream by providing integrated solutions for power distribution and control equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in energy-efficient transformer technologies, including the development of first-level energy efficiency silicon steel transformers, dry-type transformers, and new energy transformers for renewable energy applications. R&D efforts focus on improving product quality, reducing losses, enhancing reliability, and expanding into energy storage and smart grid technologies. The company also plans to increase investment in electromagnetic wire production and expand its overseas market presence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of physical products including energy-saving transformers, iron cores, and electromagnetic wires. The company employs a direct sales model involving inquiry and bidding processes, with contracts signed with major power grid enterprises and industrial customers. Additional income is derived from investment returns and government subsidies related to technology and energy efficiency projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic listed companies such as State Grid Yingda, Shuangjie Electric, Beijing Cree, and Hezong Technology, which have advantages in capital and scale. Jiangsu Yangdian positions itself as a leading private enterprise specializing in amorphous alloy transformers and energy-efficient electrical machinery, leveraging its technological innovation, product quality, and integrated supply chain to maintain a competitive edge in the energy-saving transformer market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.33 billion, representing a 131.88% increase over the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 70.34 million, a 939.68% increase. Total assets reached RMB 1.69 billion, with steady growth in revenue, production capacity, and market share. The company has shown strong growth momentum, supported by increased orders and expanded production lines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Yangdian emphasizes its commitment to energy efficiency, environmental protection, and product reliability. Its transformers feature significantly lower no-load losses (over 20% below national standards), low noise, stable performance, and reduced operating costs. The company’s proprietary amorphous alloy and silicon steel technologies, combined with advanced manufacturing processes, provide customers with high-quality, cost-effective, and sustainable electrical equipment solutions tailored for modern power grids and renewable energy integration.
